body: Integration-owner rule (Opus2, 2026-11-23, from Windows B relay #938 and Fable2 #7651). On Windows B, `origin` resolves to an SSH URL, and the runner's HTTPS-only guard refuses it: "fatal: transport 'ssh' not allowed", exit 128, before any transport runs. Every GO to Windows B names the explicit public URL and an exact refspec, for example `git -c credential.interactive=never -c core.askPass= fetch --no-tags --no-recurse-submodules https://github.com/grlap/TermAl.git refs/heads/test/<item>-<commit8>`, and asks the runner to verify that FETCH_HEAD equals the commit. No remote or config change, never SSH. A prelaunch fetch stop like this is not an environment repeat.
